modifiers_select.name: modifiers_select
modifiers_select.using:
exists (
        select 1 from modifier_groups mg
        where mg.id = "modifiers"."modifier_group_id"
          and mg.business_id = any(auth_business_ids())
      )

modifiers_insert.withCheck:

        where mg.id = "modifiers"."modifier_group_id"
          and mg.business_id = any(auth_business_ids())
      )
